paper_title: Axion mass prediction from adaptive mesh refinement cosmological lattice simulations
notes: Pure theory/cosmology paper. Uses adaptive-mesh-refinement lattice simulations of the axion-string network to predict the QCD axion DM mass, m_a in (45,65) ueV from string production (potentially up to ~300 ueV including domain-wall contributions). This is a mass prediction, not an experimental/observational exclusion on any coupling, and not an experimental sensitivity projection. No (mass, coupling) exclusion curve exists in this paper. Therefore is_new_limit=false and is_projection=false.
